name: harvest-project-status-to-zapier-table

deploy.description: Harvest project activated/deactivated -> set is_active on its row in the Harvest Projects (New) Zapier Table 01K8A2KV9X1W95GAB6Y69D7G4C. If the row doesn't exist yet (a brand-new project), waits 30 min for harvest-new-project-to-zapier-table to create it, then throws if it's still missing. Migrated from the classic Zap 'Update Harvest Project Status'.

trigger.trigger_note: Polling trigger on the private 'Harvest Project Status' app (source: ~/Repos/work-flowers/zapier/integrations/zapier-harvest/triggers/projectActiveStatusChanged.js). Each poll returns every project with dedupe id `{project_id}-{is_active}`, so a flip produces a new id. KNOWN GAP (kept deliberately, same as the classic Zap): an id is never re-delivered, so a project that goes active -> inactive -> active again does not fire the second activation. The durable polling-dedupe bug (CLAUDE.md) has the same effect here as classic dedupe.

connections_note: No connection alias: the workflow only calls Zapier Tables. The trigger authenticates with the private app's connection 0222f130-4dea-8cbe-8646-363ed384c489 (the only one on App237841CLIAPI).

connectionless_apps.TableCLIAPI: find_record / update_record — no connection, no task cost

tables.01K8A2KV9X1W95GAB6Y69D7G4C: Harvest Projects (New) — f1 project_id, f2 client_id, f3 is_active, f4 Name, f5 Project Page ID. f5 is maintained by hand outside this repo and is never written by these Zaps; update_record leaves omitted columns alone (verified 2026-09-30).

classic_zap.title: Update Harvest Project Status
classic_zap.note: The classic Zap halted silently on a missing row (`_zap_search_success_on_miss: false`). This one waits 30 minutes for the new-project Zap, then throws. It also skips the write when the row already holds the new value.
